data.name: Bratki
data.detailed_description:
Bratki (Братки) /brɐtˈkʲi/ n. 1. Literal: “little brothers”, “brothers”, “bros”.

2. Underworld / 1990s Russian slang: members of a criminal gang; fellow gangsters; trusted associates from one’s crew; street enforcers connected with organized crime.

3. Colloquial (later, softened): close mates, buddies from the same circle, “the boys”.

Shaved heads, short leather jackets, and a tinted Lada Samara or a well-worn BMW. Bloodied knuckles and a piece of rebar as the tools of making a living. Sound familiar? That's right — they're back! The legendary gangsters of the 1990s return to flex their muscles and prove their street smarts once again.

They rule the city, master the art of protection rackets, and carve up territories. They are the scourge of street kiosks, cooperatives, and black market dealers.

They are the Bratki.

Now it's your turn to step into their shoes.

  • Tactical strategy game with a healthy dose of dirty tricks.

  • Build a long criminal career, from small-time racketeer to feared crime boss.

  • Achieve your goals by any means necessary: extortion, blackmail, robbery, and contract killings.

  • Set up meetings, settle scores, negotiate with thieves and the militia, live by the criminal code, and arm your gang.

  • Be cunning, ruthless, and cautious—and nothing will stand in the way of your rise to the top.

As a bonus, the game folder also includes a guide to Russian criminal, gangster, and prison slang.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is a work of fiction. All characters, events, organizations, situations, and dialogue presented in the game are fictional, even where some elements may be inspired by real historical phenomena, social events, or criminal culture from a particular period.

The game contains depictions and references to criminal activity, violence, criminal organizations, prison and criminal culture, illegal businesses, corruption, threats, extortion, and other unlawful activities. The criminal and thieves' slang used throughout the game is presented solely as a fictional and atmospheric element reflecting the language and culture of the world depicted.

The developers and publishers of this game do not endorse, support, encourage, or promote criminal activity, violence, drug use, corruption, or any other unlawful behavior depicted or referenced in the game. The characters, events, and actions shown are not intended as examples to follow and should not be understood as an attempt to glorify, justify, or encourage a criminal lifestyle.

Any resemblance to real persons, organizations, or events is coincidental unless explicitly stated otherwise. This game is created solely for fictional, artistic, and entertainment purposes.
